## Category 1: Code Quality (3 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Fix dont_know → unsure type mismatch
**Given:** PointDetail.tsx has position type handling
**Then:** No `dont_know` references remain; all use `unsure` consistently
**Verify:** `grep -r "dont_know" src/app/prototypes/linkedin-like/` returns no results

### UAT-1.2: StoryCard has context prop
**Given:** StoryCard component definition
**Then:** Component accepts `context: 'profile' | 'point-detail' | 'story-detail'` prop
**Verify:** Read StoryCard.tsx, confirm prop type exists

### UAT-1.3: No duplicate users in display
**Given:** Point detail page with stories from multiple users
**When:** Page renders
**Then:** Each user appears only once (not in both stories list AND position breakdown)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of Point detail page with 3+ stories

## Category 2: Profile Cards UI (4 tests)

### UAT-2.1: StoryCard shows point count only
**Given:** Profile page with StoryCards
**When:** Page renders
**Then:** StoryCard shows "🔗 N points" count (not full Point position breakdowns)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of profile StoryCard

### UAT-2.2: PointCard shows collapsible user stories
**Given:** Profile page with PointCards
**When:** Page renders
**Then:** PointCard shows "▶ Your N stories" collapsed (shows even when N=0)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of profile PointCard with 0 stories and with 2+ stories

### UAT-2.3: Expand toggle has adequate touch target
**Given:** PointCard with collapsible stories section
**Then:** Expand/collapse toggle is at least 44x44px
**Verify:** Chrome DevTools MCP inspect element dimensions

### UAT-2.4: QuotedPoints hidden in profile context
**Given:** StoryCard rendered with context='profile'
**Then:** QuotedPoints component is not rendered
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot + DOM inspection (no QuotedPoints element)

---

## Category 3: Point Detail Page UI (7 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Position-grouped layout
**Given:** Point detail page with stories
**When:** Page renders (default state)
**Then:** Stories grouped by position with section headers: "═══ Agree (N) ═══", "═══ Unsure (N) ═══", "═══ Disagree (N) ═══"
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of Point detail page

### UAT-3.2: No "All" tab
**Given:** Point detail page
**Then:** Position filter tabs show only [Agree (N)] [Disagree (N)] [Unsure (N)] — no "All" tab
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of tab bar

### UAT-3.3: Tab toggle behavior
**Given:** Point detail page with all sections visible
**When:** User clicks "Agree" tab, then clicks it again
**Then:** First click filters to Agree only; second click deselects and shows all positions
**Verify:** Playwright MCP click sequence with screenshots

### UAT-3.4: No icons on position tabs
**Given:** Point detail page
**Then:** Position tabs show text only (no ✓, ✗, — icons)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of tab bar

### UAT-3.5: Empty positions show placeholder
**Given:** Point with 0 stories for a position (e.g., Disagree)
**Then:** Section shows "(no positions yet)" text
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of Point with empty Disagree section

### UAT-3.6: Position badge always visible above story
**Given:** Point detail page with stories
**When:** Both filtered and unfiltered states
**Then:** Position badge (e.g., "Agree") appears above each story card, not inside or conditionally hidden
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshots in both filtered and unfiltered states

### UAT-3.7: Verify button removed
**Given:** Point detail page
**Then:** No "Verify" button present
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot + DOM search for "Verify" text
